reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    HousingQA Sample:
      - state: Texas
      - focus_year: 2021

    Question:
      Does the law specify a minimum number of days a tenant can be late on rent
      before the landlord can file an eviction action for nonpayment?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

scenario_state(texas).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_question(minimum_days_late_before_eviction_action_for_nonpayment).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement we encoded is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(texas),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_question(minimum_days_late_before_eviction_action_for_nonpayment).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translation: TX Prop  94.206 (2021)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  TX Prop  94.206 (2021) TERMINATION AND EVICTION FOR NONPAYMENT OF RENT:
  Landlord may terminate and evict if:
   (1) tenant fails to timely pay rent/amounts due that aggregate >= 1 month's rent;
   (2) landlord notifies tenant in writing that payment is delinquent; and
   (3) tenant has not tendered delinquent payment in full before the 10th day
       after the date tenant receives the notice.
*/

/* Threshold: delinquency must be at least one month's rent. */
statute_tx_prop_94_206_delinquency_threshold(months_rent(1)).

/* Notice requirement: written notice of delinquency is required. */
statute_tx_prop_94_206_requires_written_notice(yes).

/* Cure period: tenant must be allowed until before the 10th day after receipt of notice. */
statute_tx_prop_94_206_cure_period_days(10).

/* Deterministic legal rule capturing when eviction may proceed under 94.206,
   expressed in abstract terms (with a numeric cure period in days). */
legal_tx_prop_94_206_eviction_permitted(DelinquencyInMonthsRent, WrittenNoticeGiven, DaysSinceNoticeReceipt, TenderedInFullBeforeDay10) :-
    statute_tx_prop_94_206_delinquency_threshold(months_rent(ThresholdMonths)),
    DelinquencyInMonthsRent >= ThresholdMonths,
    statute_tx_prop_94_206_requires_written_notice(yes),
    WrittenNoticeGiven = yes,
    statute_tx_prop_94_206_cure_period_days(CureDays),
    DaysSinceNoticeReceipt >= CureDays,
    TenderedInFullBeforeDay10 = no.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal inference for the question asked
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* If the statute provides an explicit day-count cure/waiting period connected to
   nonpayment eviction, treat it as specifying a minimum number of days that must
   pass (at least after notice receipt) before eviction action can proceed. */
legal_min_days_before_eviction_action_for_nonpayment(State, Year, Days) :-
    State = texas,
    Year = 2021,
    statute_tx_prop_94_206_cure_period_days(Days).

/* Determine whether the law specifies a minimum number of days. */
law_specifies_minimum_days(State, Year) :-
    legal_min_days_before_eviction_action_for_nonpayment(State, Year, Days),
    Days > 0.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Required top-level answer predicate (deterministic)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    law_specifies_minimum_days(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law specify a minimum number of days a tenant can be late on rent before the landlord can file an eviction action for nonpayment?
